checks.check: The observable objects are suspended insoluble particles. Individual water molecules are the microscopic agents, not the objects seen in the ordinary microscope. The modern text preserves the diffusion-to-Brownian-motion conceptual connection.

1827 is retained. The modern account identifies pollen-contained particles without inventing a new species or retaining the unverified Lycopodium-spore attribution. It no longer declares Brown the first observer of every related phenomenon.
checks.identity_note: Brown and the British identity remain declared historical entities with source references.

checks.check: Continued thermal influence is limited to freely suspended particles; fixed, sedimented, or solidified cases are not guaranteed arbitrary continuing motion. Temperature is described as a usual trend under comparable conditions, with viscosity also affecting the motion. Temperature is not asserted to be the only determinant.

The modern text uses short-time impulses that usually do not cancel completely instead of asserting a permanently nonzero resultant. Pressure fluctuation statements are comparative and conditioned; the few-molecule-area collision description is explicitly a simplified picture, not a two-valued model of all real liquid forces.

1905 is retained from the textbook; the new excerpt supports the mathematical-theory and measurement-testing connection without being represented as a newly fetched proof of that date. The claim is an important quantitative theory, not an exclusive first/only theory or an ideological final victory. Suspended particles remain distinct from single molecules.

At this introductory level, the microscopic thermal motion versus overall macroscopic motion distinction is retained, with coexistence explicitly allowed. The old assertion that all parts of a mechanically moving body must perform regular motion has been removed.

fig-04, page23, the figure block, caption, and figure4 reference are preserved. The text states that the figure is schematic and contains no real size or speed scale. The separate visual approval was not repeated or independently extended here.

findings.current_sentence: 平均没有固定偏向，不等于每次作用都恰好抵消。
findings.context: The sentence follows claims about random molecular motion and short-time impacts from the left and right.
findings.problem: The average is not identified as the thermal random component, and the applicable bath conditions are unstated. Readers can take it as an unconditional statement that suspended particles, or all molecular collision effects, have no directed mean. Random Brownian fluctuations can coexist with flow, sedimentation, external-force drift, and systematic drag effects.
findings.precision_of_finding: The intended zero-mean thermal-fluctuation statement is acceptable under appropriate assumptions. This is a missing scope qualifier, not a claim that unbiased Brownian fluctuations are inherently incorrect.
findings.minimum_replacement: 这里只讨论热涨落产生的随机冲量。在均匀、无宏观流动且各向同性的条件下，其平均没有固定偏向，不等于每次作用都恰好抵消；这不排除颗粒因外力或沉降等作用出现整体漂移。
findings.alternative_minimum: If retaining the existing sentence, immediately identify its average as that of the thermal random component under homogeneous, no-flow, isotropic conditions, and state that it is not a guarantee of no overall particle drift.
